sum_insured_options: ₹50,000; ₹75,000; ₹1 lakh; ₹1.5 lakh; ₹2 lakh; ₹3 lakh; ₹4 lakh; ₹5 lakh; ₹10 lakh (inferred from sub-limit table)

room_rent.note: Optional add-on upgrades to Single Private AC Room up to ₹10,000/day (SI ≥5L only); ICU then at actuals

icu.note: Upgraded to actuals if Room Rent Upgradation optional cover is purchased

copayment.display: None (mandatory); voluntary 10% or 20% available for discount
copayment.note: Zone B policyholders treated in Zone A cities bear 20% co-pay (not applicable for accidental hospitalisation). Voluntary co-pay of 10%/20% can be opted for premium discount.

sub_limits.note: Cataract per eye: ₹20,000 (SI ≤1L), ₹30,000 (SI 1.5L–3L), ₹40,000 (SI 4L–10L). No other procedure sub-limits stated.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12 mo: gastric/duodenal ulcers, varicose veins, hydrocele, undescended testes, skin surgery, fistulae/fissure; 24 mo: cataract, hernia, sinuses, haemorrhoids, stones, ENT surgery, BPH, mental illness, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, tumours/cysts, hysterectomy etc.; 36 mo: joint replacement, vertebral column surgery, deviated nasal septum, gout/rheumatism, hypertrophied turbinate, refractive error >7.5D

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Base inbuilt: 5% per claim-free year, max 25%. Optional Cumulative Bonus Enhancement add-on raises rate to 25%/yr and max to 200% of SI (for SI ≥5L)

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement (100% of base SI, once per year) is an optional paid add-on available for SI ≥5L; lifetime limit for cancer and kidney failure requiring dialysis

day_care.display: Listed procedures (399+ listed) plus any procedure <24 hrs due to tech advances

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined in the policy but no coverage clause exists for it under the operative sections

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient, govt/accredited hospitals)

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections etc.

consumables.note: Extensive non-medical/consumables exclusion list (Annexure II); gloves, ECG electrodes, masks etc. not payable

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded for all covers except Personal Accident (worldwide accident cover, payment in India)

notable_exclusions: Maternity (except ectopic), treatment outside India, OPD treatment, dental (unless accidental), external appliances, congenital external anomalies, sterility/IVF, vaccination
optional_riders: Room Rent Upgradation (Single Private AC, SI≥5L), Cumulative Bonus Enhancement (25%/yr, max 200%), Sum Insured Reinstatement (SI≥5L), Double SI for Cancer (SI≥5L), Personal Accident (200% SI for death/PTD)
